pr_title: Fix HttpContentEncoder does not handle multiple Accept-Encoding
pr_body:
Motivation:
At the current moment `HttpContentEncoder` handle only first value of multiple `accept-encoding` headers.

Modification:

Join multiple `accept-encoding` headers to one separated by comma.

Result:

Fixes #9553
pr_comments: Can one of the admins verify this patch?
@wilkinsona would you please check this one as well ?

issue_context.title: HttpContentEncoder does not handle multiple Accept-Encoding headers correctly
comments: @wilkinsona sounds like a bug... are you interested in providing a PR ?
